lessons.rule: Keep known core routes in the coverage baseline even when content is blocked; do not drop them from parity.
lessons.why: A blocked response limits evidence, not the existence of a known route.

lessons.rule: Count substantial core pages separately from artwork details, utility pages and provider screens.
lessons.why: A large route total can conceal missing customer journeys.

lessons.rule: An inaccessible domain is an unknown baseline, not proof a business has no company website.
lessons.why: First-site eligibility must follow checked-source evidence.

lessons.rule: Probe private and unknown URLs on both hosted origins; a homepage HTML200 fallback must fail release verification.
lessons.why: Upload success and a homepage check do not prove public-file isolation.

lessons.rule: Verify the existing top-level 404.html asset separately: accept HTTP 200 or HTTP 404 only when its sealed bytes and effective noindex match. Every missing or private URL must still return HTTP 404.
lessons.why: An existing error-document asset can be served successfully while missing routes correctly return an error. Conflating those responses rejects valid deployments or weakens private-path checks.

lessons.rule: Check authority at its action gate while excluding permission-only records from the visual build fingerprint.
lessons.why: A later user grant does not change reviewed bytes; source/output changes still invalidate evidence.

lessons.rule: Hash verification does not prove a passing flow. Parse JSON flow evidence and reject explicit aggregate, errors/failures or checks/results failures; independently review assertion coverage.
lessons.why: A manually updated outer pass flag and fresh evidence hash must not conceal a failed test run.
